_help: Nested searches defining 'the field', from most specific to broadest. Edit the queries freely: only new papers get processed. Syntax is OpenAlex boolean search on titles and abstracts (AND, OR, NOT, "exact phrases", parentheses). Avoid commas inside queries. A scope with more matching papers than max_full is sampled at random (sample_size papers) and its numbers become estimates with confidence intervals. Queries include French terms (OpenAlex searches titles and abstracts in any language). types: document types included (theses, reports, chapters and preprints help with grey literature).

scopes.label: Forested swamps
scopes.query: ("forested swamp" OR "forested swamps" OR "swamp forest" OR "swamp forests" OR "treed swamp" OR "treed swamps" OR "wooded swamp" OR "red maple swamp" OR "cedar swamp" OR "marécage arborescent" OR "marécages arborescents" OR "marécage boisé" OR "marécages boisés" OR "érablière humide") AND (methane OR CH4 OR "carbon dioxide" OR CO2 OR "nitrous oxide" OR N2O OR "greenhouse gas" OR "greenhouse gases" OR "carbon flux" OR "carbon fluxes" OR méthane OR "dioxyde de carbone" OR "oxyde nitreux" OR "protoxyde d'azote" OR "gaz à effet de serre" OR "flux de carbone")

scopes.label: All wetlands
